definition_en: to risk money on a game or race, or to take a risk hoping for a gain
core_image: 骰子在赌桌上滚动，筹码堆成小山
scene: 他把所有积蓄都押在赌桌上。 He gambled all his savings at the table.
sceneCN: 这里 gamble 是「赌博」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把所有积蓄都押在赌桌上。

senses.title: Risk money on a game
senses.definition: to risk money on the result of a game or race
senses.definitionCN: 拿钱押在比赛或赛马的结果上
senses.example: He gambled all his savings at the table.
senses.exampleCN: 他把所有积蓄都押在赌桌上。
senses.why: This is the central betting sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的赌博义项。

senses.title: Take a risk
senses.definition: to do something risky hoping for a good result
senses.definitionCN: 做有风险的事，希望得到好结果
senses.example: She gambled on a new career at forty.
senses.exampleCN: 她四十岁时冒险转行。
senses.why: Betting widened into any risk.
senses.whyCN: 下注扩展为任何冒险。

senses.title: A risky venture
senses.definition: an action or deal that involves a large risk
senses.definitionCN: 涉及很大风险的行动或交易
senses.example: The factory was a gamble that failed.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂是一次失败的投机。
senses.why: The verb became a noun for the risk itself.
senses.whyCN: 动词转化为表示风险本身的名词。

intro.en: Gamble grew from an Old English word for play or game.
intro.cn: gamble 由古英语中表示游戏或玩耍的词发展而来。

items.en: Gamen meant game or play.
items.cn: gamen 意为游戏或玩耍。

items.en: Gamelen meant to play for stakes.
items.cn: gamelen 意为带赌注地玩。

items.en: It named betting money.
items.cn: 它指押钱赌博。

items.en: It widened to any risk.
items.cn: 词义扩展到任何冒险。

items.en: Gamble on means trust to chance.
items.cn: gamble on 意为把希望押在机会上。

note.en: Gamble is compared with look-alike words and words for risking.
note.cn: 把 gamble 与形近词以及表示冒险的词作比较。

entries.definition: the top part of a house wall
to risk money on an outcome

normalIntro.en: Gamble is game plus stakes: play with something valuable on the line.
normalIntro.cn: gamble 是带赌注的游戏：把有价值的东西押上去。

normal.en: He gambled all his savings at the table.
normal.cn: 他把所有积蓄都押在赌桌上。

normal.en: She gambled on a new career at forty.
normal.cn: 她四十岁时冒险转行。

normal.en: The factory was a gamble that failed.
normal.cn: 这家工厂是一次失败的投机。

normal.en: Do not gamble away your future.
normal.cn: 不要把未来赌掉。

normal.en: They took a gamble on the young player.
normal.cn: 他们在这个年轻球员身上冒了一次险。

abstract.en: To gamble is to pay for hope in advance.
abstract.cn: 赌博是提前为希望付费。

abstract.en: The house always wins because it owns the game.
abstract.cn: 庄家总是赢，因为它拥有这场游戏。

abstract.en: Some risks are worth taking, but none should be hidden.
abstract.cn: 有些风险值得冒，但没有风险该被隐瞒。

examples.en: He gambled all his savings at the table.
examples.cn: 他把所有积蓄都押在赌桌上。

examples.en: She gambled on a new career at forty.
examples.cn: 她四十岁时冒险转行。

examples.en: They took a gamble on the young player.
examples.cn: 他们在这个年轻球员身上冒了一次险。

dict_mnemonic.text: gamble 与 game 同源；gamble on 是「在……上下注」，take a gamble 是「冒一次险」。

root: 由古英语 gamen（游戏）演变而来，核心义「带风险的玩局」。

sensesIntro.en: Gamble means to bet money, take a risk, or the risky venture itself.
sensesIntro.cn: gamble 指赌钱、冒险，或冒险的行为本身。

core.en: Play with something valuable at risk.
core.cn: 拿有价值的东西去玩并承担风险。

branches.en: Money is placed on a result.
branches.cn: 钱被押在一个结果上。

branches.en: A career is risked for a better life.
branches.cn: 为了更好的生活拿职业冒险。

branches.en: A factory is a large risky bet.
branches.cn: 工厂是一笔巨大的风险赌注。

branches.en: Betting and business share a gamble.
branches.cn: 赌博与生意共享 gamble 一词。

branches.en: The act and the venture belong together.
branches.cn: 动作与冒险事业彼此相属。

intro.en: Gamble builds words for bettors and betting places.
intro.cn: gamble 构成表示赌徒和赌博场所的词。

latinIntro.en: Gamble is a native English word, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: gamble 是英语本族词，不是拉丁语。

items.example: He gambles more than he can afford.
items.exampleCN: 他赌得超过了自己的承受能力。

items.example: Gambling is illegal in some places.
items.exampleCN: 赌博在一些地方是非法的。

items.example: He gambled away the family money.
His gambling debt grew every month.
items.exampleCN: 他的赌债每月都在增加。

definition_en: exactly the same in every detail, or the very same one
core_image: 两枚一模一样的指纹并排印在白纸上
scene: 双胞胎穿着一模一样的衣服。 The twins wore identical coats.
sceneCN: 这里 identical 是「完全相同的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：双胞胎穿着一模一样的衣服。

senses.title: Exactly the same
senses.definition: exactly the same in every detail
senses.definitionCN: 每个细节都完全一样
senses.example: The twins wore identical coats.
senses.exampleCN: 双胞胎穿着一模一样的衣服。
senses.why: This is the core sense of perfect sameness.
senses.whyCN: 这是完全相同的核心义项。

senses.title: The very same one
senses.definition: the very same thing, not another one
senses.definitionCN: 正是同一事物而非另一个
senses.example: This is the identical room we stayed in last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这正是我们去年住过的那个房间。
senses.why: Here the word points to one single thing.
senses.whyCN: 这里指同一个事物。

intro.en: Identical comes from Latin idem, meaning the same.
intro.cn: identical 来自拉丁语 idem，意为相同的。

items.en: Idem meant the same.
items.cn: idem 意为相同的。

items.en: Identicus meant the same.
items.cn: identicus 意为相同的。

items.en: Identique meant the same.
items.cn: identique 意为相同的。

items.en: Identical entered English meaning the same.
items.cn: identical 进入英语，意为相同的。

items.en: Identical twins became a common phrase.
items.cn: identical twins 成为常见说法。

note.en: Identical is compared with look-alike words and with words for sameness.
note.cn: 把 identical 与形近词以及表示相同的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Identical describes things that cannot be told apart.
normalIntro.cn: identical 描述无法分辨的两个事物。

normal.en: The twins wore identical coats.
normal.cn: 双胞胎穿着一模一样的衣服。

normal.en: The two copies are identical.
normal.cn: 这两份副本完全相同。

normal.en: Her answer was identical to mine.
normal.cn: 她的答案和我的完全相同。

normal.en: The two rooms look almost identical.
normal.cn: 这两个房间看起来几乎一样。

normal.en: This is the identical room we used before.
normal.cn: 这正是我们以前用过的那个房间。

abstract.en: Identical things share one shape in two places.
abstract.cn: 相同的事物在两个地方共用一个形态。

abstract.en: Sameness can hide a different story.
abstract.cn: 相同的外表可以藏着不同的故事。

abstract.en: To call things identical is to stop comparing.
abstract.cn: 称两物相同，就是停止比较。

examples.en: The twins wore identical coats.
examples.cn: 双胞胎穿着一模一样的衣服。

examples.en: The two copies are identical.
examples.cn: 这两份副本完全相同。

examples.en: This is the identical room we stayed in last year.
examples.cn: 这正是我们去年住过的那个房间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拉丁语 idem 意为相同的，经中世纪拉丁语 identicus 与法语 identique 进入英语，构成 identical，表示「完全相同的」。

root: 来自拉丁语 idem（相同的），经中世纪拉丁语 identicus 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Identical means exactly the same or the very same one.
sensesIntro.cn: identical 表示完全相同的，或正是同一个。

core.en: Two things matching so closely they cannot be told apart.
core.cn: 两个事物吻合到无法分辨。

branches.en: The two copies are identical.
branches.cn: 这两份副本完全相同。

branches.en: The twins wore identical coats.
branches.cn: 双胞胎穿着一模一样的衣服。

branches.en: This is the identical room we stayed in last year.
branches.cn: 这正是我们去年住过的那个房间。

branches.en: Sameness of detail and sameness of thing are close.
branches.cn: 细节相同与事物同一很接近。

branches.en: The two rooms look almost identical.
branches.cn: 这两个房间看起来几乎一样。

intro.en: Identical belongs to a family built on the Latin root for same.
intro.cn: identical 属于建立在拉丁语「相同」词根上的一组词。

latinIntro.en: Latin idem, the same, gives identity, identify and identical.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 idem（相同的）衍生出 identity、identify 与 identical。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 idem 意为相同的。

latinEntries.example: Identicus led to the English word.
latinEntries.exampleCN: identicus 演变为这个英语词。

definition_en: the natural light of the sun, or the time when this light is present
core_image: 清早透过窗户斜照进来的一片光
scene: 窗帘一拉开，日光就把整张桌子照亮了。 The room was bright with daylight.
sceneCN: 这里 daylight 指「日光」（第 1 个义项：太阳发出的自然光）；句意是屋子被日光照得发亮。

senses.title: The light of the sun
senses.definition: natural light coming from the sun rather than from a lamp
senses.definitionCN: 来自太阳而非灯火的自然光
senses.example: The room was bright with daylight.
senses.exampleCN: 屋子被日光照得发亮。
senses.why: The word names the light itself, the thing you can work by.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指光本身，指你能借着干活的那种光。

senses.title: The hours of light
senses.definition: the part of the day when the sun is above the horizon
senses.definitionCN: 一天中太阳在地平线以上的那段时间
senses.example: We reached the hut before daylight failed.
senses.exampleCN: 天暗下来之前我们赶到了小屋。
senses.why: The same word marks both the light and the time it lasts.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词既标记光，也标记光持续的时长。

intro.en: Daylight is an old compound of day and light, joining the two words the sun gives us.
intro.cn: daylight 是 day 与 light 的古老复合词，把太阳给我们的两样东西接在一起。

items.en: Dæg named the bright part of the cycle.
items.cn: dæg 指一昼夜中明亮的那一段。

items.en: Lēoht named light and also anything not heavy.
items.cn: lēoht 既指光，也指不沉重的东西。

items.en: The compound named the light of day as opposed to lamplight.
items.cn: 这个复合词指白天的光，与灯光相对。

items.en: Broad daylight appeared for deeds done in full view.
items.cn: broad daylight 出现，指在众目睽睽之下做的事。

items.en: Daylight hours and daylight saving fixed the word in schedules.
items.cn: daylight hours 与 daylight saving 把这个词钉进了日程表。

note.en: The look-alike group plays on day and light joining other words, and the meaning group names other kinds of brightness.
note.cn: 形近组是 day 与 light 和别的词拼接，近义组则列出其他明亮之物。

entries.definitionCN: 二十四小时的一段时间

entries.definition: the brightness that lets us see
warm light and the feeling it brings
entries.definitionCN: 温暖的光及它带来的感觉

entries.definition: the hours when the sun is up
entries.definitionCN: 太阳在上的那几个小时

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a curtain pulled open and end with a clock shifted forward for summer.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从拉开的窗帘开始，落到为夏天拨快的钟。

normal.en: Daylight is the only free thing in a room.
normal.cn: 日光是一间屋子里唯一不要钱的东西。

normal.en: Colours come back when daylight returns.
normal.cn: 日光回来，颜色也回来。

normal.en: Working by daylight means working with the world.
normal.cn: 借着日光干活，就是和世界一起干活。

normal.en: Broad daylight makes a secret impossible.
normal.cn: 光天化日让秘密无处可藏。

normal.en: Two plain words joined make one exact word.
normal.cn: 两个平常的词一接，就成了一个精确的词。

abstract.en: Picture dust turning slowly in a shaft of morning light.
abstract.cn: 想象晨光柱里慢慢翻转的灰尘。

abstract.en: Picture a page too bright to read without shading it.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸亮得不用手遮就看不清。

abstract.en: Picture a window that changes the whole colour of a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇窗改变了整面墙的颜色。

examples.en: The room was bright with daylight.
examples.cn: 屋子被日光照得发亮。

examples.en: We reached the hut before daylight failed.
examples.cn: 天暗下来之前我们赶到了小屋。

examples.en: The theft happened in broad daylight.
examples.cn: 那起偷窃发生在光天化日之下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 daylight 记成「白天的光」：day 是天，light 是光，合起来就是日光。

root: 由古英语 dæg（白天）与 lēoht（光）复合而成，原指与灯光相对的太阳光；十七世纪起有 broad daylight（光天化日）的说法，现代又用于 daylight hours、daylight saving 等作息用语。

sensesIntro.en: From the light itself, to the stretch of time that light fills.
sensesIntro.cn: 从光本身，到被这光照满的一段时间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one bright patch of morning sun on a table.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上一块明亮的晨光。

branches.en: The first sense is the light as a material to see and work by.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把光当作可以看、可以借用的材料。

branches.en: The second sense counts the hours that light can be used.
branches.cn: 第二个义项计算这光可用的小时数。

branches.en: Light and the time it lasts are the same gift in two forms.
branches.cn: 光和它持续的时间，是同一份礼物的两种形态。

branches.en: When the hours run out, the light goes with them.
branches.cn: 时间用尽，光也跟着走了。

branches.en: Every schedule in a farmhouse is written in daylight.
branches.cn: 农舍里的每张日程表，都是用日光写成的。

intro.en: Daylight is a compound whose family is built from its two halves, day and light.
intro.cn: daylight 是个复合词，它的一族由 day 与 light 两半各自长出。

latinIntro.en: Neither half is Latin: day comes from Old English dæg and light from lēoht.
latinIntro.cn: 两半都不来自拉丁语：day 出自古英语 dæg，light 出自 lēoht。

items.meaning: the hours when it is light
moving clocks to use more evening light

items.exampleCN: 这事发生在光天化日之下。

items.example: The studio is lit by natural daylight.
items.exampleCN: 工作室靠自然日光照亮。

items.example: Ten pounds for a coffee is daylight robbery.
items.exampleCN: 一杯咖啡十镑，简直是明抢。

definition_en: to design and make something that did not exist before, or to make up a story or excuse
core_image: 一张空白纸上，一只手把几个零件拼成一个从没见过的东西
scene: 车间里堆着旧齿轮和铜线，一个人整夜没睡，桌上摆着刚焊好的装置。 He did not invent the radio, but he made one small enough to carry.
sceneCN: 这里 invent 是「发明」（第 1 个义项：造出前所未有的东西），句意为收音机不是他发明的，但他做出了能随身携带的小型机。画面里的物件：齿轮、铜线、焊枪。

pos.zh: 动词：发明；创造；编造；虚构

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「发明；发明物」
由本词加 -or 构成，义为「发明家」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「有创造力的」
同带 -vent 词干的形近词，义为「阻止」

senses.title: Making something new
senses.definition: to design and produce a device, method, or idea that no one had before
senses.definitionCN: 设计并造出此前无人有过的装置、方法或想法
senses.example: She invented a lamp that runs on salt water.
senses.exampleCN: 她发明了一盏用盐水点亮的灯。
senses.why: Latin invenire meant "to come upon", from in- plus venire, "to come".
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 invenire 意为「碰上」，由 in- 加 venire「来」构成。

senses.title: Creating an idea or system
senses.definition: to create a system, word, or way of doing something for the first time
senses.definitionCN: 首次创建某种体系、词语或做事方式
senses.example: The game was invented by students waiting for a train.
senses.exampleCN: 这个游戏是等火车的学生们发明的。
senses.why: Finding and founding were once the same act: you come upon a thing and it exists.
senses.whyCN: 发现与创立曾是同一件事：你碰上某物，它才算存在。

senses.title: Making up a story
senses.definition: to create characters and events in your imagination and present them as a tale
senses.definitionCN: 在想象中创造人物和事件并当作故事讲出来
senses.example: He invented a dragon that guards the library.
senses.exampleCN: 他编了一条守着图书馆的龙。
senses.why: From "come upon" the word slid to "make up", since invention and imagination share the birth of what was not there.
senses.whyCN: 从「碰上」滑到「编造」，因为发明和想象都让不在的东西诞生。

senses.title: Faking an excuse
senses.definition: to say something false in order to escape blame or trouble
senses.definitionCN: 为了逃避责备或麻烦而说出虚假的东西
senses.example: He invented a dentist appointment and left early.
senses.exampleCN: 他编了个看牙的预约，提前走了。
senses.why: The darker edge of the same power: an invented excuse is a fiction used against someone.
senses.whyCN: 同一种能力的阴暗面：编出来的借口是对付别人的虚构。

intro.en: Invent goes back to Latin invenire, "to come upon", with no hint of machines at first.
intro.cn: invent 源自拉丁语 invenire「碰上」，起初与机器无关。

items.en: The verb venire meant "to come".
items.cn: 动词 venire 意为「来」。

items.en: in- added "upon, against", giving invenire, "to come upon".
items.cn: in- 加上「向着、碰到」，构成 invenire「碰上」。

items.en: The noun inventio meant a discovery as well as a plan.
items.cn: 名词 inventio 既指发现，也指构想。

items.en: French brought the word in as inventer, "to find out".
items.cn: 法语以 inventer「找出」把词引入。

items.en: By the eighteenth century invent meant chiefly making new devices.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，invent 主要指引造新装置。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -vent stem; the near-meaning group holds words for creating something new.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -vent 词干；近义组收表示创造新事物的词。

entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「阻止」，由 pre- 加同一词干构成。
名词义为「事件」，同一词干加 e-。

entries.definition: Acting to stop trouble before it starts.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「预防的」，同词干加 -ive。
动词义为「创造」，范围最广。

entries.definition: To plan or design a method cleverly.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「设计；想出」，偏方法。

entries.definition: To make something, often to fake it.

normalIntro.en: These hooks link the word to the moment an idea becomes a thing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它连到「想法变成实物」的那一刻。

normal.en: in- means into, and vent- means come.
normal.cn: in- 是「进入」，vent- 是「来」。

normal.en: To invent is to come into a new thing.
normal.cn: 发明就是走进一个此前没有的东西。

normal.en: The person who does it is the inventor.
normal.cn: 做这件事的人叫 inventor。

normal.en: The object produced is an invention.
normal.cn: 造出来的物件叫 invention。

normal.en: Invent an excuse and the same word turns against you.
normal.cn: 编个借口，同一个词就反过来伤你。

abstract.en: Invention is a path that was not on the map.
abstract.cn: 发明是一条地图上原本没有的路。

abstract.en: The empty bench and the first wheel share a yes.
abstract.cn: 空板凳和第一个轮子共享同一句「可以」。

abstract.en: A story invented is a room built where nothing stood.
abstract.cn: 编出来的故事，是在空地上盖起的一间房。

examples.en: Nobody knows who invented paper, but the idea travelled fast.
examples.cn: 没人知道纸是谁发明的，但这个主意传得很快。

examples.en: Do not invent figures to fill a gap in the report.
examples.cn: 不要编造数字去填报告里的空白。

examples.en: They invented a rule that no one could remember.
examples.cn: 他们造出一条谁也记不住的规则。

dict_mnemonic.text: in（进来）+ vent（来）——让一个东西第一次到来

root: 拉丁语 in「进入、碰上」+ venire「来」→ invenire「碰上」→ 古法语 inventer → 英语 invent。同族有 invention、inventor、inventive；形近 prevent、event。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: building a device, founding a system, telling an imagined story, and faking an excuse.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：造出器械、创立体例、讲述想象的故事，以及捏造借口。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing comes into being where nothing stood before.
core.cn: 核心意象：在原本空无一物的地方，有东西诞生了。

branches.en: THE BENCH: a workbench where a new machine takes shape.
branches.cn: 工作台这条线：新机器在工作台上成形。

branches.en: THE RULE: a system or word that did not exist before.
branches.cn: 规则这条线：此前不存在的体例或词语。

branches.en: THE STORY: characters born inside a head.
branches.cn: 故事这条线：在头脑里诞生的人物。

branches.en: THE LIE: a fiction aimed at escaping blame.
branches.cn: 谎言这条线：用来逃避责任的虚构。

branches.en: THE SAME POWER: both senses build what is not there.
branches.cn: 同一能力：两个义项都在造不存在的东西。

intro.en: Invent is in- "into" plus the root vent- "come".
intro.cn: invent 是 in-「进入」加词根 vent-「来」。

latinIntro.en: Latin venire, inventus and inventio are all recorded members of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 venire、inventus 与 inventio 都是这一族有记载的成员。

items.example: It also appears in invent and prevent.
items.exampleCN: 它也见于 invent 与 prevent。

items.example: The verb is the family base.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是这一族的基座。

items.example: It builds prevent, to come before and block.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 prevent，提前来到并挡住。

items.example: The same stem with e- for out gives what comes out.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干配 e-「向外」指发生的事情。

definition_en: a brush with a long handle for sweeping
core_image: 墙角立着的旧竹扫帚
scene: 院子里落满黄叶。 She took a broom and swept the step.
sceneCN: 这里 broom 是「扫帚」（第 1 个义项：带长柄的清扫工具）；句意是她拿起扫帚扫台阶。

derivatives.zh: 扫帚柄，也指故事里女巫骑的扫帚
长满金雀花的，灌木丛生的

senses.title: A brush on a long handle
senses.definition: a brush with a long handle, used for sweeping floors
senses.definitionCN: 带长柄、用来扫地的刷子状工具
senses.example: She took a broom and swept the step.
senses.exampleCN: 她拿起扫帚扫台阶。
senses.why: The tool took its name from the shrub whose branches were tied together.
senses.whyCN: 这种工具得名于被捆成一束的那种灌木枝条。

senses.title: To sweep with a broom
senses.definition: to sweep a surface with a broom
senses.definitionCN: 用扫帚清扫一个表面
senses.example: He broomed the yard before the rain came.
senses.exampleCN: 下雨前他把院子扫了一遍。
senses.why: The noun was turned into a verb naming the action of the tool.
senses.whyCN: 名词被转化成动词，指用这种工具的动作。

senses.title: A yellow-flowered shrub
senses.definition: a shrub with yellow flowers and long thin branches
senses.definitionCN: 开黄花、枝条细长的灌木
senses.example: Broom grew thick along the sandy path.
senses.exampleCN: 沙土小路两旁长满了金雀花。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, and the plant gave the tool its name.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，正是这种植物给了工具名字。

intro.en: Broom first named a shrub, then the bundle of its branches, then any sweeping tool.
intro.cn: broom 先指一种灌木，再指捆起来的枝条，最后指任何扫帚。

items.en: brōm named the yellow-flowered broom shrub.
items.cn: brōm 指开黄花的金雀花灌木。

items.en: Bundles of its branches were used to sweep floors.
items.cn: 人们把它的枝条捆起来扫地。

items.en: The tool took the name broom from the plant.
items.cn: 这种工具直接借用了植物的名字。

items.en: Broomstick appeared in tales of witches and flights.
items.cn: broomstick 出现在女巫与飞行的故事里。

items.en: broom means a brush with a long handle, and still the shrub.
items.cn: 如今 broom 指长柄扫帚，也仍指那种灌木。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the br- and -oom shape; the near-meaning group gives other cleaning tools.
note.cn: 形近组共享 br- 与 -oom 的外形；近义组是其他清洁工具。

entries.definition: a tool with short stiff hairs
a tool with a soft head for washing floors
a person or machine that sweeps

normalIntro.en: Broom is a plant name that became a household tool.
normalIntro.cn: broom 原本是植物名，后来成了家家都有的工具。

normal.en: A new broom sweeps clean.
normal.cn: 新扫帚扫得干净。

normal.en: The plural is brooms.
normal.cn: 复数是 brooms。

normal.en: A broomstick is the handle of a broom.
normal.cn: broomstick 就是扫帚柄。

normal.en: You can broom the floor as a verb.
normal.cn: broom 也能作动词，表示扫地。

normal.en: The shrub broom has yellow flowers.
normal.cn: 植物 broom 开黄色的花。

abstract.en: See a stiff bundle of twigs tied to a stick.
abstract.cn: 想象一束硬枝条被捆在木棍上。

abstract.en: See leaves swept into a neat pile.
abstract.cn: 想象落叶被扫成整齐的一堆。

abstract.en: See yellow flowers on a sandy slope.
abstract.cn: 想象沙坡上开满黄花。

examples.en: She took a broom and swept the step.
examples.cn: 她拿起扫帚扫台阶。

examples.en: He broomed the yard before the rain came.
examples.cn: 下雨前他把院子扫了一遍。

examples.en: Broom grew thick along the sandy path.
examples.cn: 沙土小路两旁长满了金雀花。

dict_mnemonic.text: broom 与 bloom 只差一个字母，花开是 bloom，把落花扫走的是 broom，一对字母就把两者连起来了。

root: broom 源自古英语 brōm，本是金雀花一类灌木的名字；人们把它的枝条捆起来扫地，工具便沿用了这个植物名，后来材质变了，名字没变。

sensesIntro.en: A plant, the bundle of its branches, and the act of sweeping.
sensesIntro.cn: 一种植物、一捆枝条做成的工具、以及清扫的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old broom standing in the corner.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙角立着的一把旧扫帚。

branches.en: sweep with a broom
branches.cn: 用扫帚扫

branches.en: a broom cupboard
branches.cn: 扫帚柜

branches.en: broom the floor
branches.cn: 扫地

branches.en: broom on a sandy slope
branches.cn: 沙坡上的金雀花

branches.en: a new broom
branches.cn: 新扫帚

intro.en: Broom forms compounds and a few derived words with -stick and -y.
intro.cn: broom 可构成合成词，也能加 -stick 与 -y 派生。

latinIntro.en: The base is Old English; the Latin items below are related only in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自古英语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

definition_en: completely different from something, or unwilling to agree with others
core_image: 两条线朝相反方向延伸，永不相交
scene: 他说往北，另一个人偏说该往南，两人谁也不让。 Contrary to the forecast, the day stayed dry.
sceneCN: 这里 contrary 指「与…相反的」（第 1 个义项：与某事完全不符）；句意是与预报相反，那天一直没下雨。

senses.title: Opposite in fact
senses.definition: completely different from what is stated or expected
senses.definitionCN: 与所述或所预期完全不同
senses.example: Contrary to the rule, the door was left open.
senses.exampleCN: 与规定相反，门被开着。
senses.why: A fact that refuses the forecast must be said out loud.
senses.whyCN: 拒绝预报的事实，得被大声说出来。

senses.title: Set against
senses.definition: opposed in direction, nature or purpose
senses.definitionCN: 在方向、性质或目的上彼此相对
senses.example: The two plans pull in contrary directions.
senses.exampleCN: 两个方案朝相反方向用力。
senses.why: Two ropes on one load can only pull apart.
senses.whyCN: 同一重物上的两根绳，只会把东西拉开。

senses.title: Stubbornly opposed
senses.definition: willing to disagree just to have one's own way
senses.definitionCN: 为了照自己的意思而执意反对
senses.example: A contrary mood kept him silent all evening.
senses.exampleCN: 一股别扭劲儿让他整晚不说话。
senses.why: Some refusal has no reason beyond the wish to refuse.
senses.whyCN: 有些拒绝，除了想拒绝本身，别无理由。

intro.en: Contrary comes from Latin contrarius, opposite, from contra, against or facing.
intro.cn: contrary 来自拉丁语 contrarius（相反的），源于 contra（反对、面对）。

items.en: Contra meant facing something or standing against it.
items.cn: contra 意为面对某物或站在它的对面。

items.en: Contrarius described things placed on opposite sides.
items.cn: contrarius 形容被放在相对两侧的事物。

items.en: The word could also describe a person who always resists.
items.cn: 这个词也能形容总是顶着来的人。

items.en: French contraire kept both the spatial and personal senses.
items.cn: 法语 contraire 同时保留了空间与人的两层意思。

items.en: English contrary came to mean opposed in fact.
items.cn: 英语 contrary 逐渐指事实上的相反。

items.en: The phrase on the contrary became a fixed reply.
items.cn: 短语 on the contrary 成了固定的应答。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin against base contr-, and the meaning group names other words for what faces the other way.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的反对词基 contr-，近义组列出其他表示反方向的词。

entries.definition: a clear difference shown by comparison
to say that something is wrong
a nation with its own land and people
as different as possible from something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a fact that refuses the forecast, then move to two forces facing apart and a will that refuses for its own sake.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从拒绝预报的事实开始，再到两股相对的力量，最后到为反对而反对的性子。

normal.en: Contra- means against, so contrary is the against word.
normal.cn: contra- 意为反对，contrary 就是那个反着来的词。

normal.en: Contrary to the plan, the day went another way.
normal.cn: 与计划相反，这一天走了另一条路。

normal.en: Two arrows from one point, pointing apart.
normal.cn: 从一个点出发的两支箭，指向两边。

normal.en: A contrary person argues before hearing the end.
normal.cn: 别扭的人还没听完就开始反对。

normal.en: On the contrary is the phrase that turns a sentence around.
normal.cn: on the contrary 就是让句子掉头的短语。

abstract.en: Picture two roads leaving one sign in opposite ways.
abstract.cn: 想象两条路从同一块路牌下朝相反方向走。

abstract.en: Picture a magnet pushing another away.
abstract.cn: 想象一块磁铁把另一块推开。

abstract.en: Picture a child crossing arms at a simple request.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子面对简单的请求抱起手臂。

examples.en: Contrary to expectations, the team won easily.
examples.cn: 与预期相反，这支队伍轻松获胜。

examples.en: The two accounts point in contrary directions.
examples.cn: 两种说法指向相反的方向。

examples.en: There is no evidence to the contrary.
examples.cn: 没有相反的证据。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contrary 记成 contra（反对）加 ry：总站在对面、朝反方向走，就是相反的。

root: 源自拉丁语 contrarius（相反的），来自 contra（反对、面对），后指事实相反、方向对立与性子固执。

sensesIntro.en: From a fact that refuses the forecast, to two forces facing apart, and at last to a will that refuses on purpose.
sensesIntro.cn: 从拒绝预报的事实，到两股相对的力量，最后到存心反对的性子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two arrows leaving one point in opposite directions.
core.cn: 核心意象：两支箭从同一点朝相反方向飞出。

branches.en: The plainest sense says a fact goes the other way.
branches.cn: 最朴素的义项是说事实走了另一边。

branches.en: Two directions can be set against each other.
branches.cn: 两个方向可以彼此相对。

branches.en: A person may also take the opposite side for pleasure.
branches.cn: 人也会为了痛快而站到对面去。

branches.en: A broken forecast and opposing forces share one shape.
branches.cn: 落空的预报与相对的力量共用一个形状。

branches.en: Opposition in space turns into opposition in temper.
branches.cn: 空间里的对立变成了脾气里的对立。

intro.en: Contrary is built on Latin contra, against, plus the adjective ending -ary.
intro.cn: contrary 由拉丁语 contra（反对）加形容词词尾 -ary 构成。

latinIntro.en: The against base contr- also runs through contrast, contradict and controversy.
latinIntro.cn: 反对词基 contr- 也贯穿 contrast、contradict 与 controversy。

items.example: The result was contrary to plan.

items.meaning: in an opposite or stubborn way
a standing of two things side by side

items.exampleCN: 不要与自己的笔记相矛盾。

items.meaning: to speak or act in return

definition_en: to break a law, rule, or agreement, or to treat something sacred with disrespect
core_image: 一个人抬脚直接踏过围起来的白线
scene: 新闻里说，这家公司被查出违反了安全规定。 The company was found to have violated safety rules.
sceneCN: 这里 violate 是「违反」（第 1 个义项：违背法律、规则或约定）；句意为这家公司被查出违反了安全规定。抬脚越过白线的那一步就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 加后缀 -ion 构成，义为「违反；侵犯」
加后缀 -or 构成，义为「违反者；侵犯者」

senses.title: To break a rule or law
senses.definition: to act against a law, rule, or agreement
senses.definitionCN: 做出违背法律、规则或约定的行为
senses.example: The company was found to have violated safety rules.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司被查出违反了安全规定。
senses.why: Latin violare meant to treat with force, and treating a rule with force is breaking it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 violare 意为以强力对待，用强力对待规则就是违反规则。

senses.title: To break into what belongs to another
senses.definition: to intrude on rights, privacy, or a person
senses.definitionCN: 侵入他人的权利、隐私或人身
senses.example: The reporter had violated her privacy.
senses.exampleCN: 那位记者侵犯了她的隐私。
senses.why: When force crosses a boundary that belongs to someone else, the word shifts from rules to persons.
senses.whyCN: 当强力越过属于他人的边界时，这个词就从规则转向了人。

senses.title: To treat something sacred with disrespect
senses.definition: to show contempt for a holy place or thing
senses.definitionCN: 对神圣的场所或事物表示轻慢
senses.example: Touching the altar was thought to violate the temple.
senses.exampleCN: 人们认为触碰祭坛是亵渎神庙。
senses.why: The oldest use is about holy places, where force feels most shocking.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的用法针对圣地，那里施加强力最令人震惊。

senses.title: To break a promise or agreement
senses.definition: to fail to keep what one has agreed to
senses.definitionCN: 没有履行已经同意的事情
senses.example: By selling the land he violated the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 他卖地，违反了合同。
senses.why: A contract is a rule two sides wrote, so breaking it takes the same verb.
senses.whyCN: 契约是双方一起写下的规则，破坏它用的是同一个动词。

senses.title: To disturb the peace of a place
senses.definition: to break the quiet or order of a place
senses.definitionCN: 打破某处的安静或秩序
senses.example: A siren violated the silence of the night.
senses.exampleCN: 一声警笛打破了夜的寂静。
senses.why: Quiet and order are also boundaries, and force across them is a violation.
senses.whyCN: 宁静与秩序也是边界，强力越过它们同样是侵犯。

intro.en: Violate comes from Latin violare, to treat with force or to outrage.
intro.cn: violate 来自拉丁语 violare，意为以强力对待或施暴。

items.en: Violare meant to use force on something, or to outrage it.
items.cn: violare 意为对某物施加强力，或加害凌辱。

items.en: Violentia, force, and violatio, an outrage, grew from the same stem.
items.cn: violentia（暴力）与 violatio（侵害）出自同一词干。

items.en: French violer brought the word into legal and moral talk.
items.cn: 法语 violer 把该词带入法律与道德的讨论。

items.en: English used violate for breaking holy things and sworn promises.
items.cn: 中世纪英语用 violate 指破坏神圣之物与立下的誓约。

items.en: Modern law applies it to rules, rights, contracts, and privacy.
items.cn: 现代法律将其用于规则、权利、合同与隐私。

note.en: The first group holds the violence family, the second the nearby verbs of breaking and keeping.
note.cn: 第一组是 violence 词族，第二组是表示违反与遵守的相近动词。

entries.definition: the act of breaking a rule
a person who breaks a rule
to fail to keep a rule or promise
to go beyond a legal limit
to do wrong or to hurt feelings
to do what a rule says

normalIntro.en: Violate, violence, and violent share one Latin stem: force used where it should not be.
normalIntro.cn: violate、violence、violent 共用一个拉丁词干：用在不该用的地方的强力。

normal.en: Violate is the verb, violation the act, violator the person.
normal.cn: violate 是动词，violation 是行为，violator 是人。

normal.en: That Latin stem viol- also gave violence and violent.
normal.cn: 拉丁词干 viol- 还产生了 violence 与 violent。

normal.en: You violate a rule, a right, a contract, or a quiet night.
normal.cn: 可以 violate 规则、权利、合同，也可以 violate 一个安静的夜晚。

normal.en: Notice the long i: VY-uh-late, not vee-.
normal.cn: 注意长音 i：读 VY-uh-late，不读 vee-。

normal.en: Keep the final -e before -ion: violation.
normal.cn: 加 -ion 前保留词尾 -e：violation。

abstract.en: See a foot stepping straight over a painted white line.
abstract.cn: 想一只脚直接跨过画好的白线。

abstract.en: Hear a door pushed open without a knock.
abstract.cn: 听一扇门没敲门就被推开。

abstract.en: Feel a siren cutting through a still night.
abstract.cn: 感受警笛划破寂静的夜。

examples.en: Drivers who violate the speed limit will be fined.
examples.cn: 超速的司机将被罚款。

examples.en: The new law violates the rights of small businesses.
examples.cn: 这项新法律侵犯了小企业的权利。

examples.en: He did not want to violate his promise to her.
examples.cn: 他不想违背对她的承诺。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「歪尔雷特」——把围栏特意掰歪了越过去，就是违反规定。

root: 拉丁语 violare（以强力对待；加害）→ violatio（侵害）→ 古法语 violer → 英语 violate

sensesIntro.en: A Latin verb for using force spreads from holy places to laws, to other people, to contracts, and to a quiet night.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个表示施加强力的拉丁动词，从圣地扩展到法律、他人、契约，以及一个安静的夜晚。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a foot stepping over a white line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只脚跨过白线。

branches.en: The rule branch: safety rules broken by a company.
branches.cn: 规则分支：公司违反安全规定。

branches.en: The person branch: a reporter and her privacy.
branches.cn: 人身分支：记者与她的隐私。

branches.en: The temple branch: a hand on the altar.
branches.cn: 神庙分支：触碰祭坛的手。

branches.en: The contract branch: land sold against the deal.
branches.cn: 契约分支：违约卖地。

branches.en: The quiet branch: a siren in the night.
branches.cn: 宁静分支：夜里的一声警笛。

intro.en: The Latin stem viol- carries force; -ate makes the verb, -ion and -or the noun and the person.
intro.cn: 拉丁词干 viol- 携带强力之义，-ate 构成动词，-ion、-or 构成名词与表人词。

latinIntro.en: Latin violare yielded violation, violator, and the whole violence family in English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 violare 派生英语的 violation、violator 以及整个 violence 词族。

items.example: Viol- carries the sense of force misused.
items.exampleCN: viol- 携带被误用的强力。

items.example: Violate is to act with force against.
A violation is the act itself.
A violator is the one who breaks it.
Violence is the state of using force.
items.exampleCN: violence 是使用强力的状态。

items.example: A violent act uses great force.
items.exampleCN: violent act 使用巨大强力。

latinEntries.meaning: to treat with force, to outrage

definition_en: a room, especially a private one, a hall where a parliament meets, or a closed space inside a body or machine
core_image: 四面围合起来的一个封闭空间
scene: 庭审结束后，法官走进里间换下法袍。 The judge retired to a private chamber.
sceneCN: 这里 chamber 指「房间」（第 1 个义项：私密的室内空间）；句意是法官退到一间私人房间。

senses.title: A private room
senses.definition: a room, especially one used for a private or special purpose
senses.definitionCN: 房间，尤指作私密或特殊用途的房间
senses.example: The council met in a small chamber.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会在一间小室里开会。
senses.why: The Greek and Latin sources named a vaulted room, so the enclosed space is the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语与拉丁语来源都指拱顶的房间，因此封闭空间是最古老的义项。

senses.title: A hall for a parliament
senses.definition: one of the groups or halls that make up a parliament
senses.definitionCN: 组成议会的机构或厅堂之一
senses.example: The upper chamber rejected the bill.
senses.exampleCN: 上院否决了这项议案。
senses.why: A parliament meets in a great enclosed hall, so the room came to name the body that sits in it.
senses.whyCN: 议会在一座巨大的封闭厅堂里开会，于是房间名转而指坐在其中的机构。

senses.title: An enclosed cavity
senses.definition: a closed space inside a machine, a body or a structure
senses.definitionCN: 机器、身体或建筑物内部的封闭空间
senses.example: Water fills the chamber before it is pumped out.
senses.exampleCN: 水先充满腔室，再被抽出。
senses.why: Any enclosed room can be shrunk to a small sealed space, which is exactly the cavity inside a machine or a heart.
senses.whyCN: 任何围合的房间都能缩小成密封的小空间，这正是机器或心脏内部的腔。

intro.en: Chamber goes back to a Greek word for a vaulted space and reached English through Latin and French.
intro.cn: chamber 可追溯到希腊语中表示拱顶空间的词，经拉丁语与法语进入英语。

items.en: Kamara named anything with a vaulted, curved roof.
items.cn: 希腊语 kamara 指任何带拱形顶的空间。

items.en: Camera named a vaulted room and later any enclosed room.
items.cn: 拉丁语 camera 指拱顶房间，后来泛指封闭的房间。

items.en: Old French chambre kept the sense of a private room.
items.cn: 古法语 chambre 保留私密房间的含义。

items.en: English chamber first names a private room in a house or castle.
items.cn: 十三世纪英语 chamber 先指住宅或城堡中的私室。

items.en: The word widens to parliament halls, machine cavities and chamber music.
items.cn: 词义扩展到议会厅、机器腔室与室内乐。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the chamber family, while the meaning group lists rooms and enclosed spaces.
note.cn: 形近组沿 chamber 词族展开，近义组列出房间与封闭空间的说法。

entries.definition: a lawyer's office or a judge's room
a woman who cleans hotel rooms

entries.definitionCN: 被分成多个封闭空间的

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the four walls and move to parliament and to hollow spaces.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从四面墙出发，走向议会与中空的空间。

normal.en: Four walls and a roof make a chamber: the idea is enclosure.
normal.cn: 四面墙加一个顶就是 chamber：核心意思是围合。

normal.en: A chamber of commerce gathers businesses in one room of influence.
normal.cn: chamber of commerce 把商家聚在同一间有影响力的屋子里。

normal.en: Chamber music was written for small rooms rather than large halls.
normal.cn: chamber music 是为小房间而非大厅写的。

normal.en: Burial chamber and gas chamber keep the plain sense of an enclosed space.
normal.cn: burial chamber 与 gas chamber 保留封闭空间的直白含义。

normal.en: The upper chamber of a parliament is a hall that became a body.
normal.cn: 议会的上院原本是一个厅，后来变成了一个机构。

abstract.en: Picture a small stone room with a curved ceiling.
abstract.cn: 想象一间带弧形顶的小石屋。

abstract.en: Picture a long hall where members rise to speak.
abstract.cn: 想象一座长厅，成员们起身发言。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed hollow inside an engine block.
abstract.cn: 想象发动机缸体里一处密封的空腔。

examples.en: The king received them in his private chamber.
examples.cn: 国王在自己的私室里接见了他们。

examples.en: The bill passed the lower chamber easily.
examples.cn: 这项议案在下院顺利通过。

examples.en: The heart has four chambers.
examples.cn: 心脏有四个腔室。

dict_mnemonic.text: chamber 与 camera 同源：最初都指「拱顶的房间」，一个成了室，一个成了相机暗箱。

root: 源自希腊语 kamara（拱顶空间），经拉丁语 camera 与古法语 chambre 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: A private room comes first, a parliament hall grows from it, and a sealed cavity extends the shape inward.
sensesIntro.cn: 私室义最先出现，议会厅义由它生长，封闭腔室义则把形状向内延伸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a space closed in by walls on every side.
core.cn: 核心意象：四面被墙围合起来的空间。

branches.en: The room sense keeps the plain enclosed space.
branches.cn: 房间义保留朴素的封闭空间。

branches.en: The parliament sense turns the hall into an institution.
branches.cn: 议院义把厅堂变成机构。

branches.en: The cavity sense shrinks the room into a hollow inside.
branches.cn: 腔室义把房间缩小成内部空腔。

branches.en: Both rest on a space built for people to gather.
branches.cn: 两者都建立在为人聚集而造的空间上。

branches.en: Room and cavity share the same enclosed shape.
branches.cn: 房间与腔室共享同一种围合形状。

intro.en: Chamber builds chambers, chambermaid and chambered, and it appears in many fixed compounds.
intro.cn: chamber 构成 chambers、chambermaid 与 chambered，并出现在许多固定复合词中。

latinIntro.en: Latin camera, a vaulted room, is the direct source of the English word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 camera（拱顶房间）是这个英语词的直接来源。

items.exampleCN: 客房女服务员换了床单。

items.example: Chambre carried the word to English.

items.meaning: an officer of a royal household

latinEntries.exampleCN: camara 保留了弧形的含义。

definition_zh: 忠诚的；忠实的；准确的；虔诚的
definition_en: loyal to a person or group; true to a promise or principle; accurate and true to the original; believing firmly in a religion
core_image: 无论风吹雨打都守在原地的那份可靠
scene: 狗对主人非常忠诚。 Dogs are very faithful to their owners.
sceneCN: 这里 faithful 是「忠诚的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：狗对主人非常忠诚。

senses.title: Loyal to a person
senses.definition: loyal and steady in support of a person or group
senses.definitionCN: 对某人或群体给予忠诚稳定的支持
senses.example: She is a faithful friend.
senses.exampleCN: 她是一位忠实的朋友。
senses.why: The core sense is steady loyalty.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是稳定的忠诚。

senses.title: True to a promise
senses.definition: remaining true to a promise, duty, or principle
senses.definitionCN: 恪守承诺、职责或原则
senses.example: He remained faithful to his word.
senses.exampleCN: 他信守自己的诺言。
senses.why: Loyalty turns from people to commitments.
senses.whyCN: 忠诚从人转向承诺。

senses.title: Accurate to the original
senses.definition: accurate and true to the original source
senses.definitionCN: 准确并忠实于原始来源
senses.example: The film is a faithful adaptation of the novel.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影是对小说的忠实改编。
senses.why: Being true to a person extends to being true to a source.
senses.whyCN: 忠于人延伸到忠于来源。

senses.title: Religious
senses.definition: believing firmly in a religion and practising it
senses.definitionCN: 坚定信仰并践行某宗教
senses.example: The faithful gathered for prayer.
senses.exampleCN: 虔诚的信众聚集祈祷。
senses.why: The noun faithful names those full of faith.
senses.whyCN: 名词化的 the faithful 指充满信仰的人。

intro.en: Faithful is faith plus the suffix -ful, meaning full of faith.
intro.cn: faithful 由 faith 加后缀 -ful（充满…的）构成。

items.en: Fides means trust and loyalty.
items.cn: fides 意为信任与忠诚。

items.en: Feid carries the sense of faithfulness.
items.cn: feid 带有忠诚之义。

items.en: Faithful means full of belief or loyalty.
items.cn: 中古英语中 faithful 意为充满信念或忠诚。

items.en: Faithful describes accurate copies.
items.cn: 早期现代英语中 faithful 描述准确的复制。

items.en: The faithful names religious believers.
items.cn: 现代英语中 the faithful 指宗教信众。

note.en: Faithful means loyal; fateful means decisive or disastrous.
note.cn: faithful 是忠诚的，fateful 则是决定性的。

entries.definition: always supporting a person or cause

normalIntro.en: Faithful is being full of faith toward a person, promise, or source.
normalIntro.cn: faithful 是对人、承诺或来源充满信义。

normal.en: A dog is a faithful companion.
normal.cn: 狗是忠实的伙伴。

normal.en: She stayed faithful to her principles.
normal.cn: 她坚守自己的原则。

normal.en: The translation is faithful to the original.
normal.cn: 这份译文忠实于原文。

normal.en: He has been faithful to the company for years.
normal.cn: 他多年来忠诚于公司。

normal.en: The faithful filled the church.
normal.cn: 虔诚的信众挤满了教堂。

abstract.en: Picture a dog waiting by the gate every evening.
abstract.cn: 想象一只狗每天傍晚守在门口。

abstract.en: Imagine a promise kept through hard years.
abstract.cn: 想象经过艰难岁月仍守住的承诺。

abstract.en: Think of a copy that keeps every detail of the original.
abstract.cn: 想象保留原作每个细节的复制品。

examples.en: He was faithful to his family.
examples.cn: 他对家庭忠诚。

examples.en: The report is a faithful record of the meeting.
examples.cn: 这份报告忠实记录了会议内容。

examples.en: They remained faithful during difficult times.
examples.cn: 在困难时期他们依然忠贞不渝。

dict_mnemonic.note: 构词记忆 · 后缀派生
dict_mnemonic.text: faith（忠诚、信仰）+ -ful（充满…的）= faithful（忠诚的），与 hopeful、careful 的构成方式相同。

root: faithful 由 faith（信任、忠诚）加后缀 -ful（充满…的）构成，最终源自拉丁语 fides。

sensesIntro.en: Faithful means loyal, true to a promise, accurate to a source, or religious.
sensesIntro.cn: faithful 意为忠诚、恪守承诺、忠实于原出处，或虔诚。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady presence that does not leave.
core.cn: 核心意象：始终不离开的稳定存在。

branches.en: The base sense is loyalty to a person.
branches.cn: 基础义是对人的忠诚。

branches.en: Loyalty extends to promises and principles.
branches.cn: 忠诚延伸到承诺与原则。

branches.en: Being true extends to sources and copies.
branches.cn: 忠实延伸到来源与复制。

branches.en: The noun use names religious believers.
branches.cn: 名词用法指宗教信众。

branches.en: A loyal person also keeps promises.
branches.cn: 忠诚的人也守承诺。

intro.en: The suffix -ful turns faith into an adjective meaning full of faith.
intro.cn: 后缀 -ful 把 faith 变成表示「充满信义」的形容词。

latinIntro.en: Faithful inherits Latin fides through Old French feid.
latinIntro.cn: faithful 经由古法语 feid 继承拉丁语 fides。

items.exampleCN: 她照食谱一丝不苟地做。

items.example: His faithfulness was never in doubt.
The translation is unfaithful to the original.
items.exampleCN: 这份译文不忠实于原文。

items.example: A faithless ally cannot be trusted.

items.meaning: a school with a religious character
items.example: The faith school admits all pupils.
items.exampleCN: 这所宗教学校招收所有学生。

items.example: The faith community organized the event.
items.exampleCN: 宗教团体组织了这次活动。

items.example: They remained faithful to the cause.

latinEntries.example: Fides is the root of faithful.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fides 是 faithful 的词根。
fidere 是 confident 的前身。

definition_zh: 穿堂风；气流；一饮之量；生啤；吃水深度
definition_en: a current of cool air coming into a room, or a single swallow of a drink
core_image: 门缝下钻进的一股冷气，贴着地面爬
scene: 冬夜的屋里暖气很足，脚边却凉飕飕的，寒气从门底渗进来。 A cold draught crept in under the door.
sceneCN: 这里 draught 是「穿堂风、气流」（第 1 个义项）；句意是一股冷风从门底下渗进来。

pos.zh: 名词：气流；一饮之量；生啤

derivatives.zh: 由 draught 加 -y 构成，义为「有穿堂风的、漏风的」
由 draught 加 man 复合而成，义为「制图员」

senses.title: A current of air in a room
senses.definition: a flow of cool air coming into a room through a window, door, or gap
senses.definitionCN: 通过窗户、门或缝隙进入房间的冷空气流
senses.example: She sat away from the window to avoid the draught.
senses.exampleCN: 她坐得离窗远些，以免被风吹着。
senses.why: The word comes from a verb meaning to draw or pull, and air literally gets pulled through a gap.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自表示「拉、抽」的动词，风正是被从缝隙里抽进来的。

senses.title: The amount swallowed at one time
senses.definition: the quantity of liquid taken in a single swallow
senses.definitionCN: 一次吞下的液体量
senses.example: He emptied the glass in one draught.
senses.exampleCN: 他一口气把杯子喝空了。
senses.why: Liquid is also drawn down the throat in one pull, so the same word names a single swallow.
senses.whyCN: 液体也是一下被「抽」下喉咙的，所以同一个词又指「一口之量」。

senses.title: Beer served from a barrel
senses.definition: beer drawn from a large container rather than poured from a bottle
senses.definitionCN: 从大桶里打出来而不是从瓶里倒出的啤酒
senses.example: The pub serves draught beer from local breweries.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒馆供应本地酒厂的生啤。
senses.why: Beer pulled from a cask is drawn out by a tap, so it takes the name of the drawing action.
senses.whyCN: 从酒桶里打出的啤酒是被龙头「抽」出来的，于是沿用了这个「抽取」动作的名字。

senses.title: The depth of water a boat needs
senses.definition: the depth of water needed for a ship to float without touching the bottom
senses.definitionCN: 船浮起时不触底所需的水深
senses.example: The harbour is too shallow for vessels of that draught.
senses.exampleCN: 这个港口太浅，容不下吃水那么深的船。
senses.why: The loaded hull draws water down around it, so the depth it pulls is also called its draught.
senses.whyCN: 满载的船体把水在四周「拉」下去，于是它拉出的深度也叫吃水深度。

intro.en: Draught is the older British spelling of the same word that appears as draft in American English.
intro.cn: draught 是英式旧拼写，与美式英语里的 draft 是同一个词。

items.en: Dragan meant to draw or pull and is the ancestor of modern draw.
items.cn: 古英语 dragan 意为「拉、拖」，是现代 draw 的祖先。

items.en: Draught named the act of drawing and then the thing drawn, including air pulled through a gap.
items.cn: draught 指「拉、抽」的动作，进而指被抽出的东西，包括穿过缝隙的空气。

items.en: The air sense is recorded from the medieval period; exact first use is uncertain.
items.cn: 表示气流的义项在中古时期已有记录，确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The drink and beer senses developed from the idea of liquid drawn at one pull.
items.cn: 饮品与生啤义从「一口气抽下的液体」这个想法发展而来。

items.en: American English settled on draft for most senses, while British English kept draught for air and beer.
items.cn: 美式英语多数义项用 draft，英式英语则保留 draught 指气流与啤酒。

note.en: The look-alike group is the same word or its family; the near-meaning group names air and drink quantities.
note.cn: 形近组是同一个词或其词族；近义组收的是气流与饮量的说法。

entries.definition: The American spelling, used for air, beer, plans and conscription.
entries.definitionCN: 美式拼写，兼指气流、生啤、草稿与征兵，与 draught 同源。

entries.definition: To pull something toward you, or to sketch with lines.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「拉；画」，是 draught 的远亲基础词。
形容词，义为「漏风的」，由 draught 加 -y 构成。

entries.definition: A light gentle wind, usually outdoors.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「微风」，多指室外，语气比 draught 温和。

entries.definition: A very small mouthful of a drink.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「一小口」，量比 draught 少得多。

entries.definition: A large quick swallow of a drink.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「一大口」，强调吞咽的动作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the single pulling image behind air, beer and boat depth.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着「抽、拉」这一个意象，串起气流、啤酒与吃水。

normal.en: Draught and draft are one word with two spellings.
normal.cn: draught 与 draft 是同一个词的两种拼写。

normal.en: Air is pulled through a gap, so a draught is always something coming in.
normal.cn: 空气是被抽进缝隙的，所以 draught 总是「进来的风」。

normal.en: Draught beer is pulled from a cask by a tap.
normal.cn: draught beer 是用龙头从酒桶里打出来的。

normal.en: In one draught copies the single pull of swallowing.
normal.cn: in one draught 照搬了「一口吞下」的那一次抽拉。

normal.en: A ship draws water around its hull, and the depth it draws is its draught.
normal.cn: 船把水在船体周围压低，压出的深度就是它的吃水。

abstract.en: Picture cold air crawling along a floor under a door.
abstract.cn: 想象冷空气贴着地面从门底下爬进来。

abstract.en: Picture a glass being emptied in one motion.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯酒被一个动作喝干。

abstract.en: Picture a hull pressing a dent into the water.
abstract.cn: 想象船体在水面上压出一道凹陷。

examples.en: Could you close the window? There is a draught.
examples.cn: 能把窗户关上吗？有风。

examples.en: They serve draught beer in the back room.
examples.cn: 他们在后屋供应生啤。

examples.en: The ferry has a shallow draught and can enter small ports.
examples.cn: 这艘渡船吃水浅，能进入小港口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抓夫特」——风从门缝被抓进来，就是穿堂风；啤酒从桶里被抓出来，就是生啤。

root: 与 draft 同源，来自中古英语 draught（拉、抽），再追溯至古英语 dragan（拉、拖、画）。由「抽进来的空气」得气流义，由「一口抽下的液体」得饮量与生啤义，由「船体压低水面」得吃水义。

sensesIntro.en: One pulling action supplies four senses: air drawn in, a swallow, beer tapped from a barrel, and water drawn down by a hull.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个「抽拉」动作给出四个义项：抽进来的空气、一口饮下、从桶里打出的啤酒，以及船体压低的水深。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cold air crawling under a door along the floor.
core.cn: 核心意象：冷气贴着地面从门缝钻进来。

branches.en: AIR: the most familiar sense is cold air entering a room.
branches.cn: 气流线：最熟悉的义项是进入房间的冷空气，即第一个义项。

branches.en: DRINK: one pull at the throat measures a single swallow.
branches.cn: 饮量线：喉咙的一次抽拉量出一口之量，即第二个义项。

branches.en: BEER: drink pulled from a cask by a tap keeps the action's name.
branches.cn: 啤酒线：用龙头从桶里打出的酒沿用了动作之名，即第三个义项。

branches.en: SHIPS: a hull draws water down, and the depth it draws is named after it.
branches.cn: 船舶线：船体把水压低，压出的深度由此得名，即第四个义项。

branches.en: A cold draught and a draught of beer both describe something being pulled toward you.
branches.cn: 冷风与一杯生啤，都在描述某物被抽向你的过程。

intro.en: Draught is a whole Germanic word that still accepts ordinary English endings.
intro.cn: draught 是完整的日耳曼语词，仍可接普通英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: No Latin ancestor is involved; the root is the same one that produced draw.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语祖先；这个词根也生出了 draw。

items.example: The old verb is the ancestor of draught.
items.exampleCN: 这个古动词是 draught 的祖先。

items.example: Draw and draught share one root.
items.exampleCN: draw 与 draught 共享一个词根。

items.example: A tap pulls draught beer from the cask.
items.exampleCN: 龙头把生啤从酒桶里打出来。

items.example: Draught beer comes from a cask.

derivatives.zh: 由 draught 加 -y 构成，义为「漏风的」

definition_en: a person whose job is to put out fires, or a person who tends a fire in a furnace or engine
core_image: 浓烟里，一个戴头盔的身影抱着水带向前冲
scene: 消防员冲进浓烟里去救人。 The fireman rushed into the smoke to save people.
sceneCN: 这里 fireman 是「消防员」（第 1 个义项）；句意：消防员冲进浓烟里去救人。

senses.title: Firefighter
senses.definition: a person whose job is to put out dangerous fires
senses.definitionCN: 以扑灭危险火灾为职业的人
senses.example: The fireman rushed into the smoke to save people.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员冲进浓烟里去救人。
senses.why: This is the main modern sense.

senses.title: Stoker
senses.definition: a person who tends the fire in a furnace or engine
senses.definitionCN: 负责照看炉子或发动机炉火的人
senses.example: The fireman shoveled coal into the engine.
senses.exampleCN: 司炉工把煤铲进发动机的炉膛。
senses.why: Steam engines needed someone to feed the fire.
senses.whyCN: 蒸汽机需要有人不断添火。

intro.en: Fireman is a plain compound of fire and man, first used for anyone who tended a fire.
intro.cn: fireman 是 fire 与 man 的直白复合词，最初指照看炉火的人。

items.en: Fyr and mann were separate words.
items.cn: fyr 与 mann 原本是两个独立的词。

items.en: Fireman named a stoker or furnace tender.
items.cn: fireman 指司炉工或看炉人。

items.en: Fireman came to mean a firefighter.
items.cn: fireman 逐渐指消防员。

items.en: Firefighter became the neutral term.
items.cn: firefighter 成为更中性的说法。

items.en: Fireman is still common in everyday speech.
items.cn: fireman 在日常口语中仍很常见。

note.en: Fireman is compared with similar-looking words and with words for rescuers.
note.cn: 把 fireman 与形近词以及表示救援者的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who puts out fires
a person who feeds a furnace

normalIntro.en: Fireman literally joins fire and man: a man who works with fire.
normalIntro.cn: fireman 字面上就是 fire 加 man：与火打交道的男人。

normal.en: The fireman carried a long ladder.
normal.cn: 消防员扛着长梯。

normal.en: A fireman wears a heavy helmet.
normal.cn: 消防员戴着沉重的头盔。

normal.en: The fireman checked every room.
normal.cn: 消防员检查了每个房间。

normal.en: An old fireman fed the steam engine.
normal.cn: 一位老司炉工给蒸汽机添煤。

normal.en: Firemen train to move through smoke.
normal.cn: 消防员训练在浓烟中行动。

abstract.en: Some people run toward what others flee.
abstract.cn: 有些人奔向别人逃离的地方。

abstract.en: A helmet hides a face but not a purpose.
abstract.cn: 头盔遮住面容，却遮不住使命。

abstract.en: To tend a fire is to keep a machine alive.
abstract.cn: 照看炉火，就是让机器继续活着。

examples.en: The fireman rushed into the smoke to save people.
examples.cn: 消防员冲进浓烟里去救人。

examples.cn: 消防员顺着梯子爬上屋顶。

examples.en: The fireman shoveled coal into the engine.
examples.cn: 司炉工把煤铲进发动机的炉膛。

dict_mnemonic.text: fireman 由 fire（火）加 man（人）构成，指与火打交道的人，现多指消防员。
